info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Merwinit Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Merwinit Produce Detail Management API enables users to effectively create and manage detailed records of produce items within the Merwinit catalog. This API provides functionalities for adding new produce details, ensuring that product information is up-to-date and accessible. Typical consumers include businesses and developers looking to integrate produce management into their applications, as well as operators responsible for catalog maintenance. Utilize this API to enhance inventory management and streamline produce operations.

post.summary: Create new details for Merwinit Produce.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details related to Merwinit Produce. The request must include all necessary information to process the details properly. Ensure to provide valid input according to the specifications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the produce operation. It should contain all the necessary information about the produce being processed.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details returned.

CreateCatalogMerwinitProduceDetailReques.title: Merwinit Produce Request

merwinit_produce_id.description: Unique identifier for the Merwinit produce.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person making the request.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

CreateCatalogMerwinitProduceDetailReques.description: Schema representing a request to create a Merwinit produce entry with details like ID, requester information, quantity, priority status, unit price, and dimensions.

Dimensions.title: Dimensions

width.description: Width of the produce in specified unit.

height.description: Height of the produce in specified unit.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inch).

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the produce.

CreateCatalogMerwinitProduceDetailRespon.title: Response for Produce Details Operation

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the record generated by the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that were matched during the operation.

pricing.description: Pricing details associated with the operation.

CreateCatalogMerwinitProduceDetailRespon.description: This schema defines the response structure for the operation related to producing details. It includes the status of the operation, the record ID, processing timestamp, matched count, and pricing information.

Pricing.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net price value of the operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the price is expressed.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates if the price includes tax.

Pricing.description: This schema describes the pricing details related to an operation. It includes the net amount, currency, and whether the tax is included.
